entities.summary: Bradley Barritt is a South African former rugby union player. He played the position of centre. Born in South Africa, he played for South Africa U21 and the Emerging Springboks. In 2008 he moved to Saracens in England and was eligible for England selection. He played for England Saxons before making his full international debut for England in 2012, going on to win 26 caps. He was selected for the British & Irish Lions' 2013 tour to Australia.
